short_hash_rule: acct-|fold- + first 4 hex chars of sha256(utf-8 name); a folder's name is '<account name>/<folder path>'
mid_rule: sha256(Message-ID without angle brackets, lower-cased), decisions #5; null when the header is missing (x- fallback computed by tern.index)

encodings.features: RFC 2047 UTF-8 B subject and display name; 8bit UTF-8 body
RFC 2047 ISO-8859-7 Q subject; iso-8859-7 8bit body
windows-1252 quoted-printable body (curly quotes, euro sign, em dash)
declared charset iso-8859-1, actual bytes UTF-8 (mislabelled)
